mapper.insert: insert into ai_analysis_task (diary_id, user_id, status, task_type, priority, retry_count, max_retry_count, created_at, updated_at) values (#{diaryId}, #{userId}, #{status}, #{taskType}, #{priority}, #{retryCount}, #{maxRetryCount}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: select id from ai_analysis_task where status = 'PENDING' order by priority asc, created_at asc limit #{limit}
mapper.update: update ai_analysis_task set status = 'PROCESSING', started_at = now(), updated_at = now() where id = #{id} and status = 'PENDING'
update ai_analysis_task set status = 'COMPLETED', completed_at = now(), updated_at = now() where id = #{id} and status = 'PROCESSING'

update ai_analysis_task set retry_count = retry_count + 1, status = case when retry_count + 1 < max_retry_count then 'PENDING' else 'FAILED' end, started_at = case when retry_count + 1 < max_retry_count then null else started_at end, completed_at = case when retry_count + 1 < max_retry_count then completed_at else now() end, error_message = #{error}, updated_at = now() where id = #{id} and status = 'PROCESSING'
update ai_analysis_task set status = 'FAILED', retry_count = max_retry_count, error_message = #{error}, completed_at = now(), updated_at = now() where id = #{id} and status = 'PROCESSING'

update ai_analysis_task set retry_count = retry_count + 1, status = case when retry_count + 1 < max_retry_count then 'PENDING' else 'FAILED' end, started_at = case when retry_count + 1 < max_retry_count then null else started_at end, completed_at = case when retry_count + 1 < max_retry_count then completed_at else now() end, error_message = '分析超时', updated_at = now() where status = 'PROCESSING' and started_at is not null and started_at < #{deadline}
